build_attentive_pooler: build an AttentivePooler with configurable query tokens, cross-attention, and transformer blocks for pooling sequence embeddings
build_attentive_classifier: build an AttentiveClassifier that combines an AttentivePooler with a linear head for multi-class classification
review_AttentivePooler_forward: review the AttentivePooler forward pass that repeats query tokens and applies cross-attention followed by self-attention blocks
review_AttentivePooler_init_weights: review the AttentivePooler weight initialization using truncated normal and rescaling for stable training
test_AttentiveClassifier_forward: test the AttentiveClassifier forward pass that pools input features and projects to class logits
